item.title: Court again halts Trump mail ballot order, appeal expected
item.description: A federal judge issued a restraining order Thursday night preventing the U.S. Postal Service from implementing President Trump's directives on mail ballot handling.

item.title: Trump's Ballroom Dispute Is Political, Not Judicial
item.description: Article III does not grant federal judges authority over the White House's interior design choices.

item.title: Judge overturns Hegseth's ban on Anthropic AI as unconstitutional retaliation
item.description: A federal judge blocked the Defense Department's ban on using Anthropic's technology, ruling it was unconstitutional retaliation.

item.title: How Oppenheimer Ended Auden's Ties with National Review
item.description: The renowned poet contributed to NR only once. Here's why.
